axioms.name: host_embedding_and_normalization
axioms.statement: P_0 is modeled as embedded in P_-1; positive and negative indexed layers may be normalized to the common host reference P_-1.

axioms.name: host_resource_invariance
axioms.statement: The formal host-resource functional is invariant in time; internal scale change does not imply creation of physical compute.

axioms.name: two_sided_fixed_point
axioms.statement: Positive and negative indexed formal sequences are declared to share the same algebraic fixed point Omega.

log_abelian_interface.semantics: The event representation is Abelian. Negative universe indices use a signed dual meta-coordinate, not the logarithm of a negative or sub-unit integer Godel number. Finite dual cancellation is a consistency surrogate and is not a proof of the A3 infinite limit.
